title: ApplicationOutboxIntent
description: Versioned immutable enqueue-intent envelope written to an application-owned outbox. Machine-readable companion to docs/04-architecture/10-application-outbox-bridge.md.

schema_version.description: Intent envelope major version. Unsupported majors MUST be rejected by bridges; additive fields use extensions or later minor documentation under the same major.

source_namespace.description: Application-selected opaque namespace that scopes source_row_id uniqueness within the application trust boundary. Not trimmed; whitespace is significant.

source_row_id.description: Opaque application-owned outbox row identity within source_namespace. Not trimmed; whitespace is significant. MUST NOT contain control characters.

target_queue.description: Named Work Queue that the bridge will enqueue into after the application transaction commits.

enqueue_request.description: Immutable Queue enqueue body (OpenAPI EnqueueTaskRequest shape). MUST NOT change after first successful publication attempt that Queue accepted or conflicted on fingerprint.

payload.description: Application-owned opaque JSON payload for the Queue task.

created_at.description: Intent creation time in UTC (RFC 3339 / ISO-8601). Used for lag = now - oldest pending created_at.

traceparent.description: Optional W3C traceparent header value propagated into Queue enqueue when present.

tracestate.description: Optional W3C tracestate header value propagated into Queue enqueue when present.

extensions.description: Additive application/bridge extension area. Unknown keys MUST be ignored by older bridges under the same schema_version major. MUST NOT alter identity, target_queue, or enqueue_request semantics.
